grammar.pattern: 再：在一个条件或步骤之后
grammar.purpose: Place a further action after a stated prerequisite
grammar.explanation: 先听，再说 orders steps. 等听清楚了再加快 makes understanding a prerequisite. 再试一次 is another future attempt; 又试了一次 reports another past attempt. 再 also appears in 如果再听不懂… for a further hypothetical occasion. Do not infer that every 再 means an event already happened.

examples.py: děng tīng qīng chǔ le zài jiā kuài .

examples.zh: 如果再听不懂，就换一个办法。
examples.py: rú guǒ zài tīng bù dǒng , jiù huàn yī gè bàn fǎ .
examples.en: If still unable to understand on another attempt, change the method.

commonMistakes.why: Use 又 for a reported repeated past event in this context.

grammar.pattern: 互相 / 相互 / 尽量 / 亲自
grammar.purpose: Coordinate reciprocal help and personal action
grammar.explanation: 我们互相帮助 / 相互帮助 describes help in both directions, unlike 我帮你 alone. 尽量 says to do as much as circumstances allow; it does not guarantee the result. 亲自 says the person acts rather than delegating; it does not mean alone or without help. 我亲自读，你帮我听 is consistent.

examples.py: wǒ men hù xiāng bāng zhù .

examples.zh: 尽量说清楚，不一定马上成功。
examples.py: jǐn liàng shuō qīng chǔ , bù yí dìng mǎ shàng chéng gōng .
examples.en: Try to speak clearly; success need not be immediate.

examples.py: wǒ qīn zì dú , nǐ bāng wǒ tīng .
examples.en: I read it personally; you help listen.

commonMistakes.wrong: 亲自读，就是不能接受帮助。
commonMistakes.right: 我亲自读，也可以请你帮助。
commonMistakes.why: Personal action does not exclude assistance.

lines.zh: 明天上台那一段，你练得怎么样？
lines.py: míng tiān shàng tái nà yī duàn , nǐ liàn de zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How's practice going for tomorrow's part onstage?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 前面还行，最后两句总忘。
lines.py: qián miàn hái xíng , zuì hòu liǎng jù zǒng wàng .
lines.en: The beginning's fine. I keep forgetting the last two lines.

lines.zh: 我们先慢慢说，不放音乐。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān màn màn shuō , bù fàng yīn yuè .
lines.en: Let's say them slowly first, without music.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，你帮我听听。
lines.py: hǎo , nǐ bāng wǒ tīng tīng .
lines.en: Okay. Listen for me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这一遍你说全了。再配上音乐试试？
lines.py: zhè yī biàn nǐ shuō quán le . zài pèi shàng yīn yuè shì shì ?
lines.en: You got every line that time. Shall we try it with music?

lines.zh: 等一下，先把最后一句再说两遍。
lines.py: děng yī xià , xiān bǎ zuì hòu yī jù zài shuō liǎng biàn .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，不急。明天我站你旁边。
lines.py: xíng , bù jí . míng tiān wǒ zhàn nǐ páng biān .

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你也上台？我以为只有我。
lines.py: nǐ yě shàng tái ? wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yǒu wǒ .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 两个人一起，你唱第一句，我接第二句。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén yì qǐ , nǐ chàng dì yī jù , wǒ jiē dì èr jù .
lines.en: Together. You sing the first line; I'll take the second.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我有把握多了。现在放音乐吧。
lines.py: nà wǒ yǒu bǎ wò duō le . xiàn zài fàng yīn yuè ba .
lines.en: That makes me much more confident. Put the music on now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，准备。
lines.py: hǎo , zhǔn bèi .
lines.en: Okay. Ready?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 等一下，我刚把水拿起来。
lines.py: děng yī xià , wǒ gāng bǎ shuǐ ná qǐ lái .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 明天社区有一场小演出，我和陈宇一起唱一首歌。今天他来帮我练习，我反复唱到最后两句，却每次都忘了一句。
lines.py: míng tiān shè qū yǒu yī chǎng xiǎo yǎn chū , wǒ hé chén yǔ yì qǐ chàng yī shǒu gē . jīn tiān tā lái bāng wǒ liàn xí , wǒ fǎn fù chàng dào zuì hòu liǎng jù , què měi cì dōu wàng le yī jù .
lines.en: Chen Yu and I are singing at a small community show tomorrow. Today he came to practise with me. I kept reaching the last two lines and forgetting one.

lines.zh: 他关掉音乐，让我先慢慢说。我看着纸读了两遍，再把纸放下。这一次说全了，心里也没有刚才那么急。
lines.py: tā guān diào yīn yuè , ràng wǒ xiān màn màn shuō . wǒ kàn zhe zhǐ dú le liǎng biàn , zài bǎ zhǐ fàng xià . zhè yī cì shuō quán le , xīn lǐ yě méi yǒu gāng cái nà me jí .
lines.en: He turned off the music and asked me to say it slowly. I read from the paper twice and put it down. This time I said every line and felt less rushed.

lines.zh: 陈宇想放音乐，我说再练两遍。他就坐在旁边，等我把最后一句说清楚。说完我才发现，刚才一直把两个词的顺序弄反了。
lines.py: chén yǔ xiǎng fàng yīn yuè , wǒ shuō zài liàn liǎng biàn . tā jiù zuò zài páng biān , děng wǒ bǎ zuì hòu yī jù shuō qīng chǔ . shuō wán wǒ cái fā xiàn , gāng cái yì zhí bǎ liǎng gè cí de shùn xù nòng fǎn le .
lines.en: Chen Yu wanted to put on the music, but I asked for two more tries. He waited beside me as I said the last line clearly. I realised I'd been reversing two words.

lines.zh: 我们商量好明天一起上台。我唱第一句，他接第二句。音乐响起来，他向我点头，我这次就跟上了。
lines.py: wǒ men shāng liáng hǎo míng tiān yì qǐ shàng tái . wǒ chàng dì yī jù , tā jiē dì èr jù . yīn yuè xiǎng qǐ lái , tā xiàng wǒ diǎn tóu , wǒ zhè cì jiù gēn shàng le .
lines.en: We agreed how we'd sing together onstage. I'd sing the first line and he'd take the second. When the music began he nodded to me, and this time I kept up.

lines.zh: 练完以后，我说想先喝点水。他刚答应，就又放起音乐。我举着杯子看他，他也笑了，赶紧停下来。
lines.py: liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ shuō xiǎng xiān hē diǎn shuǐ . tā gāng dā yìng , jiù yòu fàng qǐ yīn yuè . wǒ jǔ zhe bēi zi kàn tā , tā yě xiào le , gǎn jǐn tíng xià lái .
lines.en: After practice I asked for some water. He agreed, then started the music again. I looked at him over my cup; he laughed and quickly stopped it.

lines.zh: 晚上我把要穿的衣服放好，又给陈宇发消息，说明天门口见。他回了一句，记得带水。我说水会带，最后两句也会带。
lines.py: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ yào chuān de yī fú fàng hǎo , yòu gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , shuō míng tiān mén kǒu jiàn . tā huí le yī jù , jì de dài shuǐ . wǒ shuō shuǐ huì dài , zuì hòu liǎng jù yě huì dài .
lines.en: That evening I laid out my clothes and messaged Chen Yu about meeting at the entrance tomorrow. He reminded me to bring water. I'd bring water, I said, and the final two lines too.

lines.py: tā kè fú le jǐn zhāng , zǒu shàng wǔ tái .
lines.en: She overcame her nerves and went onstage.

lines.zh: 我们一起想办法克服这个困难。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ kè fú zhè gè kùn nán .
lines.en: Let's find a way to overcome this difficulty together.

lines.zh: 有什么困难，就告诉我。
lines.py: yǒu shén me kùn nán , jiù gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: Tell me if you're having difficulties.

lines.zh: 这道题对我来说有点困难。
lines.py: zhè dào tí duì wǒ lái shuō yǒu diǎn kùn nán .
lines.en: This question is a little difficult for me.

lines.zh: 这间旧屋准备改造为书店。
lines.py: zhè jiān jiù wū zhǔn bèi gǎi zào wèi shū diàn .
lines.en: This old building will be converted into a bookshop.

lines.zh: 厨房改造以后，地方大多了。
lines.py: chú fáng gǎi zào yǐ hòu , dì fāng dà duō le .
lines.en: The kitchen is much bigger after the remodelling.

lines.zh: 漏水了，我们得采取措施。
lines.py: lòu shuǐ le , wǒ men děi cǎi qǔ cuò shī .
lines.en: There's a leak; we need to take action.

lines.zh: 他们采取了新的办法。
lines.py: tā men cǎi qǔ le xīn de bàn fǎ .
lines.en: They adopted a new approach.

lines.zh: 我们采用了小周的建议。
lines.py: wǒ men cǎi yòng le xiǎo zhōu de jiàn yì .
lines.en: We took up Xiao Zhou's suggestion.

lines.zh: 这家店采用网上订位。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn cǎi yòng wǎng shàng dìng wèi .
lines.en: This shop uses online reservations.

lines.zh: 下周我们加强最后一段的练习。
lines.py: xià zhōu wǒ men jiā qiáng zuì hòu yī duàn de liàn xí .
lines.en: We'll put more practice into the final section next week.

lines.zh: 下雨的时候，工作人员加强检查。
lines.py: xià yǔ de shí hou , gōng zuò rén yuán jiā qiáng jiǎn chá .
lines.en: The staff carry out more checks when it rains.

lines.zh: 快迟到了，我们加快脚步吧。
lines.py: kuài chí dào le , wǒ men jiā kuài jiǎo bù ba .
lines.en: We're almost late. Let's walk faster.

lines.zh: 这次练习我想加快一点速度。
lines.py: zhè cì liàn xí wǒ xiǎng jiā kuài yī diǎn sù dù .
lines.en: I'd like to speed up a little in this practice run.

lines.zh: 我今年的目标是读完这十本书。
lines.py: wǒ jīn nián de mù biāo shì dú wán zhè shí běn shū .
lines.en: My goal this year is to finish these ten books.

lines.zh: 我们的目标是七点到家。
lines.py: wǒ men de mù biāo shì qī diǎn dào jiā .
lines.en: We're aiming to get home at seven.

lines.zh: 你的新厨房进展怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ de xīn chú fáng jìn zhǎn zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How's the work on your new kitchen going?

lines.zh: 今天的练习有了一点进展。
lines.py: jīn tiān de liàn xí yǒu le yī diǎn jìn zhǎn .
lines.en: We made a little progress in practice today.

lines.zh: 灯关掉一盏，效果更好。
lines.py: dēng guān diào yī zhǎn , xiào guǒ gèng hǎo .
lines.en: Turning off one light gives a better effect.

lines.zh: 这个办法效果不错。
lines.py: zhè gè bàn fǎ xiào guǒ bù cuò .
lines.en: This approach works well.

lines.zh: 最近工作压力有点大。
lines.py: zuì jìn gōng zuò yā lì yǒu diǎn dà .
lines.en: Work's been a little stressful recently.

lines.zh: 你别给自己太大压力。
lines.py: nǐ bié gěi zì jǐ tài dà yā lì .
lines.en: Don't put too much pressure on yourself.

lines.zh: 两个人的力量比一个人大。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén de lì liàng bǐ yī gè rén dà .
lines.en: Two people have more strength than one.

lines.zh: 她的鼓励给了我力量。
lines.py: tā de gǔ lì gěi le wǒ lì liàng .
lines.en: Her encouragement gave me strength.

lines.zh: 他下决心每天早起。
lines.py: tā xià jué xīn měi tiān zǎo qǐ .
lines.en: He resolved to get up early every day.

lines.zh: 她的决心很大，不肯放弃。
lines.py: tā de jué xīn hěn dà , bù kěn fàng qì .
lines.en: She's determined and won't give up.

lines.zh: 这道题我有把握。
lines.py: zhè dào tí wǒ yǒu bǎ wò .
lines.en: I'm confident about this question.

lines.zh: 你有把握找到那家店吗？
lines.py: nǐ yǒu bǎ wò zhǎo dào nà jiā diàn ma ?
lines.en: Are you confident you can find that shop?

lines.zh: 蛋糕第一次就做成功了。
lines.py: dàn gāo dì yī cì jiù zuò chéng gōng le .
lines.en: The cake turned out right on the first try.

lines.zh: 演出很成功，大家都很高兴。
lines.py: yǎn chū hěn chéng gōng , dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng .
lines.en: The performance was a success and everyone was happy.

lines.zh: 这是大家一个月工作的成果。
lines.py: zhè shì dà jiā yī gè yuè gōng zuò de chéng guǒ .
lines.en: This is the result of a month's work by everyone.

lines.zh: 展览上能看到学生们的成果。
lines.py: zhǎn lǎn shàng néng kàn dào xué sheng men de chéng guǒ .
lines.en: You can see the students' work at the exhibition.

lines.zh: 她在音乐上有很大的成就。
lines.py: tā zài yīn yuè shàng yǒu hěn dà de chéng jiù .
lines.en: She has significant achievements in music.

lines.zh: 完成这件事，让他很有成就感。
lines.py: wán chéng zhè jiàn shì , ràng tā hěn yǒu chéng jiù gǎn .
lines.en: Finishing this gave him a strong sense of accomplishment.

audio.zh: 两个人一起，你唱第一句，我接第二句。
audio.py: liǎng gè rén yì qǐ , nǐ chàng dì yī jù , wǒ jiē dì èr jù .
audio.en: Together. You sing the first line; I'll take the second.

audio.zh: 晚上我把要穿的衣服放好，又给陈宇发消息，说明天门口见。他回了一句，记得带水。我说水会带，最后两句也会带。
audio.py: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ yào chuān de yī fú fàng hǎo , yòu gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , shuō míng tiān mén kǒu jiàn . tā huí le yī jù , jì de dài shuǐ . wǒ shuō shuǐ huì dài , zuì hòu liǎng jù yě huì dài .
audio.en: That evening I laid out my clothes and messaged Chen Yu about meeting at the entrance tomorrow. He reminded me to bring water. I'd bring water, I said, and the final two lines too.

tasks.statement: Chen Yu asks the narrator to leave the water at home.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly describes a different action.

AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三16, 三17. Native check: 再 conditional/sequencing senses versus 又 past repetition, 互相/相互 reciprocity, 尽量 limits, 亲自 versus 独自; 采取措施 versus 采用方法 collocations. Actual partial achievements only; no invented learner grading. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三11 / 三33 / 三14 / 三21: 张张纸都有标题，一张一张地看。, 六个人四张纸，还缺两张。, 她曾经住这里，旧店早已搬走。, 自从毕业，我们很少见面。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: last two tickets for a Saturday show, returning to a relocated bookshop, a twenty-minute riverside walk after three meetings, and shared rehearsal with water-break teasing. Removed assessment-rule monologues and inflated coverage recycling from dialogue and readings. All 88 word records retain IDs and receive two independent contexts. Self-review: Saturday show at seven, third row and twenty-yuan tickets; bookshop moved at beginning of year, meet at three; walk twenty minutes, no running; Lin An sings first and Chen Yu second, no solo performance. False statements contradict their own heard clip. Existing grammar ownership and assessment IDs retained. Native flags: written register 仅/已/变为/至今, 空 kōng versus kòng, informal 有的是, habitual 往往 versus 总是, 采取/采用, 成果/成就, and teasing about bringing one’s head. Native review pending.
